cases.case_label: AluY c.4052_4053ins328 in exon 4 of RP1 (Korean/East Asian founder)
cases.disease: Macular dystrophy / cone-rod dystrophy (autosomal recessive RP1-related)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 328-bp AluY insertion between c.4052 and c.4053 in RP1 exon 4 causes a frameshift (p.Tyr1352Alafs*9); found in trans with a truncating RP1 variant in five Korean probands with macular/cone-rod dystrophy.
cases.quote: it revealed AluY c.4052_4053ins328/p.(Tyr1352Alafs*9) insertion in RP1 exon 4
